title: Bitcoin ETFs log inflows as cold wallet hack reignites custody debate
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $382 million in two-day inflows, with Galaxy’s Bitcoin ETF returning to gains as the Coldcard incident renewed custody concerns.

title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
summary: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

title: Bitcoin price-metric basket sees longest capitulation since FTX blow-up: Glassnode
summary: Glassnode confirmed that its aggregate BTC price cycle tool was in its coldest phase since the collapse of FTX in late 2022.

title: BlackRock brings tokenized money market funds to Europe via JPMorgan
summary: JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform will tokenize select BlackRock money market fund shares denominated in pounds, euros and US dollars.

title: Proof of Play to shut down after blockchain gaming thesis falls short
summary: The a16z-backed studio will open-source Pirate Nation assets, while an independent foundation continues supporting the PIRATE token.

title: Forgd brings its crypto market-maker leaderboard to DefiLlama
summary: Forgd’s ratings draw on data from more than 500 token projects and 35 market-making firms, but do not solely reflect trading performance.

title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
summary: The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.

title: MiCA list expands with 12 companies in fourth post-deadline update
summary: ESMA’s latest MiCA update brings the number of authorized CASPs to 321 and adds three entities to its non-compliant register.

title: Taiwan plans Travel Rule for domestic crypto transfers from October
summary: Taiwan’s regulator plans to apply the Travel Rule to domestic VASP transfers from October before extending it to overseas platforms by the end of 2027.

title: Missouri trio charged over alleged Bitcoin kidnapping plot
summary: The defendants allegedly traveled from Missouri to Connecticut to kidnap a Bitcoin holder and force him to transfer cryptocurrency before abandoning the plan.
